messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Sure, my phone number is 555-123-2002. My name is John Smith. Let me know if you need anything else!

Thank you for providing your information. To help resolve your MMS issue, I’ll need to ask a few questions and guide you through some quick checks:

1. Can you confirm if you are able to send regular text (SMS) messages, or is it only picture/group messages (MMS) that are not working?
2. Are you seeing any error messages when you try to send an MMS, or do they just fail to send without any notification?

Once you confirm, I’ll walk you through the necessary troubleshooting steps.

I haven’t noticed any issues with regular text messages—those seem to go through fine. It’s just the picture messages (MMS) that aren’t working. When I try to send an MMS, it just fails to send without any specific error message.

First, let’s check if your phone currently has cellular service, as MMS requires a network connection. Please look at your phone’s status bar (the area at the top of your screen) and let me know:

- Do you see signal bars, or does it say “No Service” or show an airplane icon?
- Is your phone connected to the cellular network?
